text: uh one thing im a bit confused about, so, i am testing the ak47, i click to paint it, it asks me for an atlas size, i click on the recommended, i start painting, i leave the app, come back, go to the ak47, and click paint again, and its asking me again for an atlas size. but shouldnt that already be covered now ?

events.text: Fixed (76d0404c6, hot-reload). Root cause: the Create Paint Atlas gate (atlasReadyRef) resets on every model mount, so a model WITH a saved painting still re-prompted for atlas size and never restored. Now entering paint on a model that has saved variants on disk restores the latest (changeDetail to its resolution + __model_paint_program_apply) and skips the prompt; only unpainted models prompt. Threaded paintTarget={kind,id} from ModelDocumentSurface into ModelView so it can find its own paints/. User's flow (paint->Save->quit->reopen->paint) now restores Painting 1 instead of re-prompting. Note: restore fires on paint-entry, not model-open — matches their click-paint flow.
